long_biography.plain_text:
Rudolph studied mineralogy at Ruhr University Bochum before moving into pharmaceutical marketing with Behringwerke and medical-device maker Coloplast. In 1992 he founded Home Service Care to support stoma patients after hospital discharge. The model grew nationwide and broadened into nutrition, wound care, continence, ventilation, pharmacy and oncology services, eventually becoming GHD. Private-equity partnerships financed acquisitions and an integrated production, logistics and homecare network.

Handball remained a separate, highly visible chapter. Rudolph had played in the Bundesliga and briefly coached OSC Rheinhausen before injury ended his playing career. He later became majority owner, principal funder and president of HSV Hamburg, backing a period that brought domestic and European titles. After leaving GHD’s active management in 2020, he retained an advisory connection and later returned to healthcare entrepreneurship as co-managing director of Gesundheit von Morgen.

After leaving GHD’s active management in 2020, he retained an advisory connection and later returned to healthcare entrepreneurship as co-managing director of Gesundheit von Morgen.
